production_contract_source: Actual Rust Engine export/replay with unchanged v3 model inputs and raw results, immutable committed Cloud support calibration asset, exact-source decoder and separately fingerprinted support abstention
grouping: At most eight source windows per serial physical request, actual encoded bytes bounded, original four state questions plus four independent SOURCE0 support questions with namespaced IDs
identity: Explicit provider-reported versioned-model evidence pins exact returned dated model and provider/upstream route. Remote model weights and serving revision remain independently unverified, never invented.
runtime_policy: calibrated_support_raw_state_v1; raw states unchanged; fitted support must agree with raw choice and meet its original frozen threshold; rejected support is unassessed
source_support: Each kind has supported/absent/unclear choice. Questions and choices do not imply assigned work; a tentative choice alone is no open question. SOURCE0-only evidence; adjacent context cannot supply the event. Multiple same-kind states require unknown.
calibration_context: Original96 real calibration jobs/180 requests retain their original manifest and context identity; reuse requires exact fixture/judgment/window/request/wire/identity equivalence. No new calibration inference is claimed.
replay: Only the new policy accepts recorded parsed-service JSON plus its actual Engine typed result; exact decoder equality is required before gate application. Historical raw policies keep their original parser and fit.
